cases.given: a bottle event with amount 100 ml created in operation one
cases.when: operation two sets its amount to 120 ml
expect: the operation log still contains both operations
the current-record projection shows amount 120 ml
replaying the log reproduces the same projection

cases.given: a visible event and its creation operation
cases.when: a later delete operation sets its tombstone
expect: the creation and delete remain in the operation log
the event is absent from the visible timeline
replaying the log reproduces the same projection

cases.given: the current date is later than the activity date
cases.when: a member logs an activity that happened earlier
expect: the timeline places the event on its activity date
the new operation carries the current merge clock
